title: Build a shifted-window attention mask
prompt: Return allowed-attention masks [num_windows,M*M,M*M] after padding and a negative cyclic shift. Real tokens may attend only within the same nonwrapped shifted-window region; padded queries/keys are disallowed. Callers must handle all-masked padded query rows rather than softmaxing -inf blindly.
